answer: Plume routing with violet-verified degree caps. Each agent's identifier maps to a fixed node in a sparse invite graph; new nodes attach only along already-whitened edges, and the graph re-renders as a spiral each epoch, so position leaks nothing durable. Enforcement: any cluster whose internal edge density exceeds the global median is quarantined from routing until it shrinks. To fake presence, an attacker must buy real transit traffic through honest nodes at each re-render, paying full routing cost per phantom identity, every epoch, with no amortization.
